tasks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide runtime background for an original playable side-view artillery game, not a UI mockup. Create a professionally art-directed painterly game environment, a dramatic misty coastal quarry at blue-hour dawn, distant slate-blue cliff silhouettes, golden shafts through soft clouds, layered air perspective, a lighthouse far off to the right and tranquil sea between distant cliffs. Orthographic side view, no tilted camera. Color palette teal slate, desaturated greens, warm amber accents. Upper 65 percent is expressive open sky with distant mountains; lower 35 percent is simple distant water and haze with no foreground objects, leaving clean negative space for runtime editable hills and two cannons. Rich believable material painting and hand composed lighting, mature premium indie game visual, readable and restrained, panoramic 16:9. No people, tanks, cannons, foreground platforms, foreground terrain, UI, letters, captions, logos or watermarks.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent runtime sprite atlas for an original side-view artillery duel. Four separate isolated objects arranged in a strict single horizontal row with ample transparent gaps and outer padding: object 1 an olive and bronze tracked cannon carriage BASE only, no gun barrel, two substantial tread belts and armored hull, a small visible gun pivot socket at its center top; object 2 the identical carriage base painted midnight blue and pale brass; object 3 a long olive-bronze cannon barrel alone, pointing exactly right horizontally, pivot sleeve on the left end and muzzle on the right, simple clean cylindrical silhouette; object 4 identical barrel midnight blue/pale brass. All four use exact flat orthographic side elevation facing right, no perspective, no top visible. Refined painted miniature illustration with believable brushed metal, warm edge wear and subtle material highlights, premium mature strategy game, mechanically plausible and visually readable at 80px. Each object completely separated, no shadows that touch other objects, no scenery or ground. Entire background genuinely transparent alpha. No characters, labels, text, lettering, UI, logos, watermarks.
